title: vaultengine JSON-RPC 2.0 API
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio: one UTF-8 JSON message per line, in both directions. Params are by-name objects. The root schema accepts a single message or a batch.

index.build.summary: Create or incrementally update the index.

index.status.summary: Whether the index exists and is up to date.

vault.stats.summary: Summary numbers for the indexed vault.

notes.pick.summary: Fuzzy-find notes by title and alias.

note.get.summary: Properties, tags, headings, blocks and links in/out of one note.

vault.check.summary: Every violation of the format, per note, with line numbers.

vault.fix.summary: Repair missing mirrors and missing required headings (safe write path).

vault.coverage.summary: Sources nothing links to, and notes that cite no source.

note.new.summary: Create a note of a type; refused if it would add a violation.

note.link.summary: Relate note A to note B and write the mirror in B.

note.set.summary: Set a metadata value of a note.

note.ingest.summary: Turn a document into a note; nothing is written if it duplicates one.

reason.description: Why a 'changed' check looked at every note (the index needs a rebuild).
reason.title: Reason

checked.description: False: not changed itself, but affected by a changed or deleted note.
checked.title: Checked

unlinked.description: Sources no other note links to.
unlinked.title: Unlinked

titles_compared.description: [the document's title, the note's closest title]
titles_compared.title: Titles Compared

content_overlap.description: Null when a text is too short to compare.
content_overlap.title: Content Overlap

limit.description: Max items per category (null = all). Summary counts are never limited.
limit.title: Limit

HealthReportRequest.description: Link and structure problems. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
HealthReportRequest.title: HealthReportRequest

orphans.description: Notes no other note links to.
orphans.title: Orphans

dead_ends.description: Notes with no resolved links to another note.
dead_ends.title: Dead Ends

full.description: Re-parse every note and re-resolve every link.
full.title: Full

IndexBuildRequest.description: Create or incrementally update the index. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
IndexBuildRequest.title: IndexBuildRequest

forced.description: Unchanged notes re-parsed because of a full run.
forced.title: Forced

links_changed_elsewhere.description: Of those, links in notes not re-parsed whose result changed.
links_changed_elsewhere.title: Links Changed Elsewhere

IndexStatusRequest.description: Whether the index exists and is up to date. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
IndexStatusRequest.title: IndexStatusRequest

stale.description: True if index.build would change anything; null if not built.
stale.title: Stale

synced.description: Written notes now up to date in the index.
synced.title: Synced

pending.description: Written notes left 'changed' for vault.check changed=true.
pending.title: Pending

NoteGetRequest.description: Properties, tags, headings, blocks and links in/out of one note. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
NoteGetRequest.title: NoteGetRequest

links_in.description: Resolved links from other notes (self-links excluded).
links_in.title: Links In

dry_run.description: Check and return the diff; write nothing.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

path.description: A .md, .txt or .html file the server can read.
path.title: Path

content.description: The document itself, instead of path; needs filename.
content.title: Content

filename.description: Original file name (decides the kind); with content.
filename.title: Filename

type.description: Note type with an ingest: block.
type.title: Type

NoteIngestRequest.description: Turn a document into a note; nothing is written if it duplicates one. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
NoteIngestRequest.title: NoteIngestRequest

status.description: duplicate: an existing note matches; nothing written (see duplicates).
status.title: Status

already.description: Parts of the request that were already so, e.g. an existing mirror.
already.title: Already

new_violations.description: Why a write was refused: violations it would add.
new_violations.title: New Violations

tolerated.description: Violations already in the notes written; they do not block a write.
tolerated.title: Tolerated

recovered.description: Files restored from an interrupted earlier write.
recovered.title: Recovered

candidates.description: The closest existing notes, duplicates first (up to 5).
candidates.title: Candidates

dry_run.description: Check and return the diff; write nothing.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

target.description: Note B: gets the mirror if the relation has an inverse.
target.title: Target

NoteLinkRequest.description: Relate note A to note B and write the mirror in B. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
NoteLinkRequest.title: NoteLinkRequest

dry_run.description: Check and return the diff; write nothing.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

type.description: A note type of the format, e.g. zettel.
type.title: Type

name.description: File name without .md; default: from the title per the type's new.name.
name.title: Name

values.description: Metadata values; {now} works for date keys.
values.title: Values

relations.description: Relations to existing notes; their mirrors are written there.
relations.title: Relations

NoteNewRequest.description: Create a note of a type; refused if it would add a violation. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
NoteNewRequest.title: NoteNewRequest

dry_run.description: Check and return the diff; write nothing.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

key.description: A metadata key of the note's type.
key.title: Key

value.description: As written in the note, e.g. '#supported'; {now} works for date keys.
value.title: Value

NoteSetRequest.description: Set a metadata value of a note. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
NoteSetRequest.title: NoteSetRequest

query.description: Space-separated tokens, each matched as a subsequence.
query.title: Query

NotesPickRequest.description: Fuzzy-find notes by title and alias. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
NotesPickRequest.title: NotesPickRequest

total.description: Matching notes before the limit was applied.
total.title: Total

target.description: As written; empty for same-note links.
target.title: Target

reason.description: Set when a version or setting change forces a rebuild.
reason.title: Reason

positions.description: Indexes of matched characters in matched_text.
positions.title: Positions

relation.description: A relation of the format, e.g. supports.
relation.title: Relation

Response.description: Any response this server sends: a method result or an error.

reason.description: Why this one is not repaired automatically.
reason.title: Reason

changed.description: Only notes added or changed since the last index.build, plus violations they cause elsewhere.
changed.title: Changed

limit.description: Max notes listed (null = all). The summary is never limited.
limit.title: Limit

VaultCheckRequest.description: Every violation of the format, per note, with line numbers. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
VaultCheckRequest.title: VaultCheckRequest

notes.description: Notes with violations, by path; violations by line.
notes.title: Notes

limit.description: Max items per list (null = all). Counts are never limited.
limit.title: Limit

VaultCoverageRequest.description: Sources nothing links to, and notes that cite no source. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
VaultCoverageRequest.title: VaultCoverageRequest

dry_run.description: Check and return the diff; write nothing.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

VaultFixRequest.description: Repair missing mirrors and missing required headings (safe write path). Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
VaultFixRequest.title: VaultFixRequest

status.description: written; refused (would add violations, nothing written); dry-run; unchanged.
status.title: Status

already.description: Parts of the request that were already so, e.g. an existing mirror.
already.title: Already

new_violations.description: Why a write was refused: violations it would add.
new_violations.title: New Violations

tolerated.description: Violations already in the notes written; they do not block a write.
tolerated.title: Tolerated

recovered.description: Files restored from an interrupted earlier write.
recovered.title: Recovered

remaining.description: All violations left once the fix is applied.
remaining.title: Remaining

VaultStatsRequest.description: Summary numbers for the indexed vault. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
VaultStatsRequest.title: VaultStatsRequest

most_wanted.description: Unresolved targets by number of linking notes.
most_wanted.title: Most Wanted

line.description: Where it is, or for something missing, where it belongs.
line.title: Line

related.description: Another note involved: for missing-mirror, the note whose field implies it.
related.title: Related

status.description: written; refused (would add violations, nothing written); dry-run; unchanged.
status.title: Status

already.description: Parts of the request that were already so, e.g. an existing mirror.
already.title: Already

new_violations.description: Why a write was refused: violations it would add.
new_violations.title: New Violations

tolerated.description: Violations already in the notes written; they do not block a write.
tolerated.title: Tolerated

recovered.description: Files restored from an interrupted earlier write.
recovered.title: Recovered

changes.description: What was done, for people: 'line 11: added [[X]] to `supported-by::`'.
changes.title: Changes

diff.description: Unified diff of the file (against /dev/null for a new file).
diff.title: Diff

content.description: The whole new file, for action 'create'; null otherwise.
content.title: Content
